entries.source_evidence: Player exact direction from Day278 ~17:30 caravan exposed roadside camp: "Let’s get to know people in the caravan". This authorizes normal evening conversation, not V's own speech or spending, future travel actions or watch assignments. At ~Day278 18:15 V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar join wagonmaster SELLA BRANT at cooking fire. Among the existing exactly three company drivers total are Sella, IDRA KEMM and TOLLEN BRAS; two previously established hired guards, one newly named NARA VETCH, one unnamed on normal duty. Idra: adult outgoing freight driver, 11 years on Veyr-Eastwatch commercial road carrying cloth/iron fittings/household goods, with nearly 7-year-old daughter who wants a real horse despite six wooden toy horses. Tollen: older, humorous mustached freight driver, previously lost wagon temporarily on shallow river crossing and commercial cargo; still paying replacement harness. Nara: adult sharp-eyed professional spear guard, worked city service until 3 years ago; changed to freight security for better pay, less supervision and convivial colleagues. Sella: lost a previous driver to winter weather and poorly maintained bridge, hence conservatively avoids rushing horse teams and shortcuts, insists on inspection of crossings. Fenar jokes about ox strength and likes Nara, Mara warmly corrects her, Cirren chuckles and accepts tea. No extra caravan members or magic offers, no objective family proof, freight cargo/ownership and personal property unchanged. Sella observes V traveling with scholar, priest, strong warrior and visible floating silver sword and asks V: "What brings the four of you all the way out here? Business, adventure, or heading home?" **V has not answered**. His ancestry, mission and private knowledge are not automatically disclosed. The Day278 daytime chance event with Edran Fenn was already resolved, no second encounter roll permitted that travel day, no new combat or rest; camp remains open roadside not safe-city. V48/48 HP HD7/7 MP7/7, full psi/superiority/action surge; Cirren51/51 HP HD6/6 full spells; Fenar59/59 HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6; Mara healthy. Four healthy owned horses and sound coach remain at camp, V purse969gp3sp6cp, provisions21 ration-person-days/28 horse-feed animal-days, unopened single Pixie Dust held by V; weighted LongRest2/6. Night278 not played and no resources/coins/time apart from conversational minutes spent. Social exchange is not a natural sync boundary; no sync_trigger marker.

entries.source_evidence: Player exactly said: "We are adventurers solving problems that are hard to solve for money. And discovering some interesting things along the way. This journey, we are traveling to Eastwatch to maybe learn more about my family history." and directed "Dont give them much more than that." At Day278 approximately6:15–6:30PM at ordinary open roadside camp east of Caer Veylan, V responds to Sella Brant's question why the four travelers head east. V tells wagonmaster and nearby Harrow & Pike caravan companions only that his party are adventurers who resolve difficult problems for money and discover interesting things, and that Eastwatch journey may help V learn more about his family history. V does NOT divulge Nightglass Hall, the silver-veined heart, the visions, V's parentage, demigod ancestry, A-04, secret genealogy, old investigations, possessions' capabilities or private personal details. Respect his express discretion: Mara/Cirren/Fenar do not volunteer secrets or contradict the response in front of these new strangers. Sella independently expresses ordinary goodwill about V finding answers without probing; Nara jokes about her own hired-guard problem-solving and wages; Idra jokes about paying for conversation; Tollen jokes about bad camp-stew reputation. Friendly social rapport only, no formal contract beyond existing no-fee convoy accompany agreement, no independent romantic pledge, completed investigation, invitation, new offer, extra quest or cargo/security authority. The night camp continues with relaxed discussion of mundane inns/roads/food. No additional random encounter; Day278 daytime social event already used day's maximum. No in-world overnight or qualifying rest, no Day279, no combat, dice, magic, limited resource, custody, spending, food/feed debit. V48/48 HP HD7/7 all full class resources; Cirren51/51 HD6/6 full slots; Fenar59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6; Mara healthy; four healthy V-owned horses, intact coach; V purse969gp3sp6cp, carried rations21 person-days/feed28 animal-days, one unopened Pixie Dust, LongRest2/6. New conversation is routine, NOT an actual natural sync boundary: no sync_trigger.

entries.source_evidence: Player exact direction at Day278 ~6:30PM open roadside camp with Sella Brant's eastbound Harrow & Pike freight caravan after the limited family-history conversation: "Settle in and ravage both mara and fenar". V wants to retire privately and initiate a mutually desired intimate night with adult, existing romantic companions Mara and Fenar. Both independently willingly reciprocate; their reciprocal consent is present, not presumed from prior history. Fenar first honors her voluntarily promised early camp watch and only joins later after handing the watch back to Sella's ordinary paid guards, without requiring V to choose a watch shift. Mara and V spend time in privacy, and Fenar joins them after her watch; scene fades to black without explicit sexual acts or special mechanical benefits/penalties. Their relationship remains freely reciprocal with no irrevocable exclusivity/compulsion/personal oath. No V exact spoken dialogue invented, and no romantic interaction with any caravan stranger. The caravan remains peaceful and its ordinary paid guards independently cover other watches. Day278 daytime random SOCIAL occurrence already happened d1004/type87, so per established travel rule one random encounter maximum per travel day, **do not roll a night occurrence**; no danger, damage or resource interruption established. By dawn Day279 the whole party completes one quiet qualifying WILDERNESS overnight Short Rest, adding1 weighted unit to the current Long Rest cycle2/6->3/6, NOT a full Long Rest. Fenar's earlier early watch ends with ample night remainder for her own full overnight qualifying rest; V Reborn can be motionless four hours. Everyone was already full HP and full spendable class/psi/spell features, so no new HD, spells or feature use/recovery assumed beyond maintaining full values. No Pixie Dust used, no special item or coin transfer. Camp remains on open eastern Veyr Caer Veylan–Eastwatch road with Sella's three wagon convoy; departure Day279 NOT yet played, no Day279 daytime encounter generated. Day279 just DAWN, before camp breakfast/horse-feed allocation: leave carried travel stocks21 ration-person-days,28 horse-feed animal-days unchanged until actual Day279 consumption; V purse969gp3sp6cp unchanged. V48/48 HD7/7 and full resources, Cirren51/51 HD6/6 full slots, Fenar59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Mara healthy; all four V horses healthy, coach intact, one sealed Pixie Dust held by V.
